task.title: Sign in, or set up the server
task.shortdesc: You sign in with your email and password, and optionally a code from your phone. The very first time, you create that account with the server's admin token.

context.p: Open your Command Centre address, for example https://command.desktopmachineshop.com. What you see depends on the server:

ul.li: Set up Command Centre appears only while the server has no account yet.
Otherwise you see the Command Centre sign-in form.

step.cmd: First time only: create your account.

substep.cmd: In Admin token, paste the ADMIN_TOKEN from the server's Railway variables.

info.p: This proves the server is yours. You need it only this once.

substep.cmd: Fill in Name, Email, Password (at least 10 characters) and Repeat password, then choose Create account.

stepresult.p: You are signed in. Next time, sign in with your email and password.

step.cmd: Enter your Email and Password and choose Sign in.
If two-factor authentication is on, enter the 6-digit Code from your authenticator app and choose Verify.

info.p: Lost your phone? Enter one of your recovery codes instead. Each one works once.

result.p: The app opens on the Inbox. The session lives in a secure cookie: nothing secret is stored in the browser. You stay signed in on this device until you sign out in Settings, or sign it out from another device.

concept.title: Signing in with the admin token

conbody.p: Use an admin token instead connects with the server's admin token and, optionally, another server's URL. It is meant for automation and recovery: the token is saved in this browser until you sign out, it has no account (so Settings can't change a password or two-factor), and the in-app help opens in a new tab rather than a side panel.

ul.li: Can't reach the server. Check your connection. The server is down or redeploying: wait a minute and reload.
Too many wrong attempts lock sign-in for a short while. The form says how long.
